$Comment: The Headless Horseman's glow as he winds up a swoop in the saddle: the game's own charge highlight (Saw_Charge_VFX, the yellow sheen its Gobliterator wears before a dash), with none of that effect's ground marker or saw sparks, since he winds up in the air. His Ride (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride) puts it on him as the one-second wind-up starts; Duration carries it a little past the launch.
